plannedClaims.proposition: 1. Sign into the Microsoft Teams admin center with one of the following roles:Teams Telephony AdministratorTeams Communications AdministratorTeams AdministratorSee Use Teams administrator roles to manage Teams to read about getting admin roles and permissions. 2. In the left navigation, go to Voice > Phone numbers, and then select Add.ImportantFor you to see the Voice option in the left navigation in the Teams admin center, you must first buy at least one Enterprise E5 or E3 license, one Phone System add-on license, or one Audio Conferencing add-on license. 3. On the resulting page, enter a name for the order and add a description. 4. Select From Operator. 5. On the Location and quantity section, do the following steps:Under Country or region, select a country or region.Under Number type, select the desired number type for this order.If you are submitting an order for a phone number to be used by a user for calling plan, select User (subscriber).If you are submitting an order for a Toll- or Toll-free phone number to be used for Audio conferencing, select Dedicated conference bridge (Toll) or Dedicated conference bridge (Toll Free) respectively.If you are submitting an order for a Toll- or Toll-free phone number to be used for Voice applications (Call Queue or Auto Attendant) select Call Queue (Toll/Toll Free) or Auto Attendant (Toll/Toll Free) accordingly.For more information on number usage types, See Number usage types.Under Operator, select Microsoft as the operator.Under Quantity, enter the number of numbers that you want for your organization.Under Search for new numbers, select your criteria.
